mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT b.business_id, b.name, b.address, b.stars, b.review_count, b.is_open, b.categories, b.bid,
ROUND( 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(b.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(b.longitude) - RADIANS(#{longitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(b.latitude)) ), 2 ) AS distance
FROM business b
LEFT JOIN merchant_dishes md ON b.business_id = md.business_id
AND (b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{businessName}, '%') OR b.categories LIKE CONCAT('%', #{businessName}, '%') OR md.dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{businessName}, '%'))
AND b.is_open = 1
AND b.latitude IS NOT NULL AND b.longitude IS NOT NULL
AND b.latitude BETWEEN #{latitude} - (#{distance} / 111) AND #{latitude} + (#{distance} / 111) AND b.longitude BETWEEN #{longitude} - (#{distance} / (111 * COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})))) AND #{longitude} + (#{distance} / (111 * COS(RADIANS(#{latitude}))))
AND 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(b.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(b.longitude) - RADIANS(#{longitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(b.latitude)) ) <= #{distance}
ORDER BY
distance ASC,
b.stars DESC, b.review_count DESC

select business_id,name,address,stars,review_count,is_open,categories,bid from business
and city like concat('%',#{city},'%')
and is_open != 0
order by stars desc,review_count desc limit 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business (`name`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `stars`, `review_count`, `is_open`, `categories`, `attributes`, `hours`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `bid`) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{city}, #{state}, #{postalCode}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{stars}, #{reviewCount}, #{isOpen}, #{categories}, #{attributes}, #{hours}, NOW(), NOW(), #{bid})
mapper.select: SELECT business_id, name, address, stars, review_count, is_open, categories, bid FROM business ORDER BY business_id DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{pageSize}

SELECT business_id, name, address, stars, review_count, is_open, categories, bid, -- 球面距离计算公式（保留2位小数） ROUND( 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{userLat})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(#{userLng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{userLat})) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) ), 2 ) AS distance FROM business WHERE -- 基础过滤：排除已关闭/无效商户 is_open = 1 -- 经纬度非空（避免计算异常） AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL -- 动态经纬度范围过滤（覆盖50km） AND latitude BETWEEN #{userLat} - (50 / 111) AND #{userLat} + (50 / 111) AND longitude BETWEEN #{userLng} - (50 / (111 * COS(RADIANS(#{userLat})))) AND #{userLng} + (50 / (111 * COS(RADIANS(#{userLat})))) -- 直接过滤距离≤50km（替代HAVING，语义更优） AND 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{userLat})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(#{userLng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{userLat})) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) ) <= 50 -- 排序：距离升序，评分降序 ORDER BY distance ASC, stars DESC LIMIT 20
